articles.title: Heroic Feats of Soldiers of KPA Overseas Operations Units Remembered in Russia
articles.summary: A commemorative tablet was ceremoniously unveiled at the Pantheon of Defenders of the Motherland, operated by the Defence Ministry in Moscow Region, Russia. This event, reported by North Korea's KCNA, likely honours military personnel or significant defence achievements. For SSB aspirants, such ceremonies underscore the importance of military history and national defence institutions in major global powers.

articles.title: German arms export licences for Israel surge with focus on sub project
articles.summary: Germany approved almost 800 million euros ($913m) in arms export licences to Israel within the first five months of 2026. This sum exceeds exports from the previous 20 months combined, according to the Berlin government. This substantial increase signifies Germany's intensified defence support for Israel, indicating a significant shift in their bilateral security relationship with potential regional implications.
